convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'ColorJJRSX' which is a non-standard custom indicator, requiring the .ex5 file or source to replicate in Python. Trading logic itself is straightforward but custom indicator dependency prevents auto-convert.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one

custom_logic_notes: The '_Tm_Plus' suffix indicates the EA includes a time management module allowing trade session filtering (start/end time). The ColorJJRSX is a Jurik RSX (refined smoothed RSI) indicator - a zero-crossing oscillator. Signal reversal closes the opposite position before entering a new one. SL and TP default to 0 meaning the EA relies on signal reversal for exits rather than fixed SL/TP. The EA name pattern (Exp_ColorJJRSX_Tm_Plus) follows the standard MQL5 CodeBase template for signal-based EAs with time filtering.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorJJRSX (Jurik RSX) indicator is not available as a standard Python library. Options: 1) Implement Jurik RSX from scratch using the JRSX algorithm (double-smoothed momentum with adaptive filtering), 2) Approximate with a heavily smoothed RSI using EMA double-smoothing, 3) Export indicator values from MT5 via CSV or socket. The time filter module is straightforward to replicate. Signal logic is simple zero-line crossover. Position management is single-position with opposite-side close on reversal. No digit adjustment needed as SL/TP are zero.
